Need to map to Wikidata-style relations.

We need to produce triplets with subject_type and object_type.

Potential triplets:

1. (ASCII, incorporated into, Unicode character set) – relation maybe "included in" or "incorporated into". Use "included in". subject_type: "character encoding". object_type: "character set".

2. (ASCII, numeric code range, first 128 symbols) maybe not needed.

Better: (7-bit ASCII characters, have same numeric codes in, Unicode character set) relation "has same numeric code as". Could be "numeric code equivalence". Use "has same numeric code as". object_type: "character set".
